title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1991-09-09
lineage: 16 bit 48kHz DAT Master > TASCAM DA-20 (SPDIF out) ->  LynxTWO-B Audio Reference Interface (SPDIF in) ->  Wavelab 6.0
source: B&K 4011 110 degrees ORTF > Neumann BS 48i-2> Modified Sony TCD D-10 Pro (FOB  Set 1 Hand Held, Section 3, Row S, On Aisle Set 2 On Stand, Section 3, Row V, Seat 2)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a solid 1991 set with standout Dark Star and Music Never Stopped, despite a weak opening with Picasso Moon.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is full‑bodied and clear, giving space for the short Playin’ and Dark Star jams to breathe. The show builds after a shaky start with “Picasso Moon,” delivering a powerful mid‑set The Other One and an especially memorable Music Never Stopped, while LLR stays over the top as usual.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review praises the audience source and highlights several strong performances, offset only by a lukewarm opening; overall rating reflects good show quality and excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the tape as full, fat, and spacious – a great alternative to the crunchy 1991 soundboard mixes that can be hard on headphones.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts slowly with “Picasso Moon,” but the mid‑set The Other One signals a relaxed pacing that stretches into an expansive Music Never Stopped jam, giving the impression of a longer, more adventurous set.

band_member_comments.Keys: Mentions Bruce Hornsby's heavy piano on soundboards making them crunchy; prefers audience tape for keyboard clarity.
